effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
[End of Opponent's Turn] You may choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Your opponent attacks with the chosen Digimon.
